This is a concrete maintainability / drift risk grounded in the diff. Also, `createAllCalendarEvents` performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside a `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop, which is a sequential per-destination DB query in a booking hot path (an N+1 pattern as collective size grows).
